item.title: Recorder Concerto in C major, Rv 443
item.description:
Vivaldi&rsquo;s Recorder Concerto in C major, RV 443 is an important work in the recorder repertoire. Its memorable melodic writing and clear changes of character have allowed the piece to remain widely loved, while its technical demands also require a strong level of control from the performer.
Hsing-An Lee Recorder Recital in Hsinchu, Taiwan Recorder: Hsing-An Lee Harpsichord: Machiko Suto
